entities.summary: Aleksandr Syrei is a Belarusian professional ice hockey defenceman. He currently plays for Shakhtar Soligorsk of the Belarusian Extraliga. Syrei began his professional career with HK Gomel of the Eastern European Hockey League's Division B and played with that organization for five seasons.
